title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned The Foundation Stone. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Foundation Stone
options.thesis: An institution incised into water-formed stone — permanence read by light and shadow.
options.viewport: A full-bleed travertine wall; the headline cut as a V-groove the raking sun reveals, three bronze plaques as the actions.
options.risk: Stone turns mausoleum if the light never moves — it must stay warm and alive.

raised.raise: One continuous carved datum line generates the whole composition.
The page is one persistent stone wall, not stacked bands.
The active section lights along its full carved span.

options.label: The Cadastral Survey
options.thesis: Africa plotted to survey — every market a measured claim, its truth in the legend.
options.viewport: A full-bleed survey sheet: the headline as a title block, the world as a triangulated plot, the legend as navigation.
options.risk: Also where a data-forward run in this category lands — familiar map grammar.

options.label: Hand-Bent Neon Circuit
options.thesis: The networks as one continuous glass stroke that ignites — water and power drawn as a lit circuit.
options.viewport: A dark wall where a single unbroken tube bends into the headline and one word ignites cobalt.
options.risk: Neon reads nightlife, not institutional due diligence.
options.case: Fuses cleanly with Waterlight's water-and-power story and a continuous-network thesis; loses on institutional tone.
options.kept: When the room goes dark, one active run ignites.

options.label: Laboratory Counter
options.thesis: Verified figures as physical, layered numerals — honest counts, never animated theatre.
options.viewport: A black steel instrument panel, the Africa-is-Now indicators glowing in stacked tube banks.
options.risk: An instrument the audience operates, not capital it reads.
options.case: Serves the verified-indicators and impact sections with literal honesty; narrow as a whole-page frame.

options.label: The Data Portraits
options.thesis: Hard statistics drawn as unapologetic graphic argument — Africa stated, not asserted.
options.viewport: A cream board where the thesis is a hand-inked plateau chart, its caption lettered beneath.
options.risk: Its charts carry the data sections but not the portfolio or the routing.
options.case: Maximum African-founded identification and bold statistical argument; strongest on the data surfaces, thin as a whole-page frame.

options.label: Curved-Crease Shell
options.thesis: One crease turns a flat sheet into a load-bearing shell — capital as structure.
options.viewport: A cream disc lifts along one charcoal arc into a saddle that carries the headline.
options.risk: Reads as origami craft, not institutional capital.
options.case: Fuses poorly: investors do not identify with paper engineering.
options.kept: One structural gesture generates the whole composition.

options.label: The Minihompy
options.thesis: One furnishable room as the whole identity — a surface you arrange and revisit.
options.viewport: An isometric room whose furnishings are the portfolio, counters as small honest chrome.
options.risk: Reads as social nostalgia, not an investment platform.
options.case: Fuses poorly: no institutional investor identifies here.
options.kept: The whole identity is one persistent surface, furnished.

options.label: Grid Horizon Sunset
options.thesis: Markets on one horizon the grid keeps arriving underneath — capital moving forward.
options.viewport: A cyan grid runs to a striped sun on the horizon, the title extruded above it.
options.risk: Reads as retro novelty against institutional restraint.
options.case: Fuses poorly: nostalgia conflicts with due-diligence seriousness.
options.kept: The active row lights along its full width.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What an institutional investment platform ships, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Photographic hero, logo row, business cards, insights grid — the expected arrangement at full craft.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
